The site faced conversion into a convention center by MHADA and BMC. Menon highlighted that the ground had been actively used by footballers across age groups for nine years after being granted to the MFA in 2011. He criticized authorities for taking unilateral decisions without consulting the MFA or offering an equivalent alternate ground in Bandra. Dismissing technical claims about the land's past reservation on paper, Menon emphasized that sports is vital for character building and nation-building. Pointing out that a city of twenty million people has only seven full-sized football turfs, he maintained that "sports is bigger than everything else" and affirmed that the legal struggle to protect sporting space for young players will persist.
